notes.title: FarmZone Art Style Update: Embracing a Stylized World!
notes.notes:
Howdy Farmers!


🌾 First and foremost, a HUGE shoutout to our incredible exwalt and FarmZone community! 🌾

We can't thank you enough for your unwavering support and patience as we cultivate the ultimate farming adventure. Your enthusiasm has been the fertilizer that keeps our FarmZone dream growing strong. 🌱🚜

Now, let's talk visuals, shall we? 🎨

If you've been keeping an eye on our Steam page. Those early images were like baby seeds just starting to sprout, but now, oh boy, are we excited to unveil our brand new art style! 🖌️✨

We've waved farewell to vector style and embraced a fantastical stylized world. Get ready to dive into a realm bursting with vibrant personality, charm, and whimsical wonders. Every frame is a masterpiece, and every moment is an enchanting adventure waiting to be discovered. 🌟🌻

//Demo Scene
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39408427/00376424b44b58dfcb62a3d29ee3a4f32a3a88a2.png

Our dedicated team has been hard at work, refining every pixel, tweaking every detail, and pouring our hearts into creating an experience that's not just a game but a visual feast for your eyes. 🌈🎮

So, hang tight, farmers! The FarmZone you've been waiting for is sprouting into something truly magical. Stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and all the farm-tastic fun you can handle! 🤠🐮🌽
//Character Concept
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39408427/ebaeff70069b4f6222a58c7b580ae73f767ac56f.png

Wait until you see the concept drawings of our villages...

Note:
The images used are only concept drawings. Images for the game will be shared soon.

Thanks for being part of our FarmZone family. Together, we're going to grow something amazing! 🌱🌟

Stay muddy, stay marvelous, and stay FarmZone-tastic!

Let's meet on Discord:

https://discord.com/invite/3baFb2z2Ze

With love,
The exwalt Team 🚜❤️
